name: Bento grid
looksLike: tiles of different sizes arranged like a collage
one large box next to several smaller boxes
dashboard of uneven rectangles fitted neatly together
definition: A layout of differently sized tiles arranged into a tidy grid to highlight related features or information.

notConfusedWith.difference: Groups one item; a bento grid arranges several containers with different visual emphasis.

prompts.short: Add a bento grid with varied tile sizes that stacks on small screens.
prompts.detailed: Add a responsive grid of related tiles with one featured tile spanning extra columns on larger screens. Stack tiles on small screens, keep DOM order aligned with the visual reading order, and use meaningful headings. Avoid fixed heights that clip text when zoomed.

reactTailwind: <section aria-label="Product features" className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3">
